config.no_win_hunting: Finish the fixed rated schedule even if a 2600 win occurs; do not add games simply to obtain one.
config.promotion: Validation selects at most one implementation candidate. Fresh confirmation must have colour-pair bootstrap 95% lower score bound above 0.5 versus the baseline, score at least 0.5 versus previous newest, and no candidate runtime failure. Otherwise retain baseline.

games.host_load_scope: Host-wide average during game and initialization; includes all applications, not per-engine utilization or an isolated-core guarantee.
